label: Early-sequence step(s) right after a v (weaker: after c)
explanation: Fires during the original (input) phase on the token immediately after an input v, with a weaker decaying trace one step further (two after v), and more weakly on the token after c. It is strongest when v is early in the sequence: top activations are at step 2 after a leading v (v v f ...: 0.57 on the token after the first v, 1.0 on the next). The trace weakens and then disappears as the v moves later; after t>=6 it is mostly silent, and on the <DEL> step it fires only when v/c came right before it. It never fires at t=0 and is essentially silent in the copy phase. Low-magnitude activations (<0.2) are scattered over early original-phase tokens with no v/c and are not captured. prev_tok==v alone has 76% precision and 58% mass recall. Dev split: P 0.68, R 0.75, F1 0.71, mass recall 0.89.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: v, c, k, a, e, u; least: r, z, g, 0) and the input two steps back (most: v, c, e, k, a, 3; least: r, p, g, 0); timing cues that raise it most: t=2, t=1, L=9 & t=1.
